name: Santiago Betancur Duque
summary: Senior Software Engineer shipping fast, accessible and secure web products end to end: React, Next.js and Angular frontends, Spring Boot services on AWS.
about: 👋 Hi! I'm a Computer Engineer and full-stack developer from Medellín, Colombia, with 2.5+ years shipping production software at Pragma, from React, Next.js and Angular interfaces to reactive Spring Boot services on AWS.

🔎 A problem solver, curious by nature: I dig into the business need, design the right solution and build it with Clean Architecture, EDA and DDD, with measurable results in performance, security and SEO.
🤝 I mentored 3 editions of Pragma's full-stack bootcamp (30+ students hired) and co-founded the Frontend chapter's AI initiative. 2x AWS Certified: Cloud Practitioner and AI Practitioner.
